svg.text: Six microservices on a two-node K3s cluster, provisioned by Vagrant on VirtualBox, images pulled from Docker Hub.
v1.36 · flannel VXLAN over the host-only NIC
also runs the node agents: kubelet · kube-proxy · containerd · flannel
joins with the token shared through /vagrant
pods are scheduled on either node
Secrets · from .env, never written to a file
messages wait in billing_queue while billing-app is stopped
Kinds, ports, replica bounds and storage mirror Manifests/. Logos: Simple Icons (CC0) · Kubernetes icons (Apache-2.0).
